formulas.name: ManagedFinalPaymentDateFormula
formulas.expression: IF({!RecurringType} = "Open", NULL, IF({!IsVerifiedStripeScheduleFormula}, {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.finalPaymentDate}, CASE({!GiftTransactionPeriodPicklist}, "Daily", {!StartDate} + ({!GiftTransactionInterval} * ({!PlannedInstallments} - 1)), "Weekly", {!StartDate} + (7 * {!GiftTransactionInterval} * ({!PlannedInstallments} - 1)), "Monthly", ADDMONTHS({!StartDate}, {!GiftTransactionInterval} * ({!PlannedInstallments} - 1)), "Yearly", ADDMONTHS({!StartDate}, 12 * {!GiftTransactionInterval} * ({!PlannedInstallments} - 1)), {!StartDate})))

fields.name: StripePreviewSummary
fields.fieldText:
Confirm Stripe subscription change

Current Stripe: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.currentAmount} every {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.currentInterval} {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.currentPeriod}

Proposed: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.requestedAmount} every {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.requestedInterval} {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.requestedPeriod} ({!RecurringType})

Change effective date: {!StartDate}

First actual payment date: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.firstPaymentDate}

Final payment date: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.finalPaymentDate}

Stripe action: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.actionMode}

Full invoice on effective date: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.willGenerateFullInvoice}

Billing warning: {!PreviewStripeRecurringChange.businessWarning}

All Stripe billing mutations use no proration. Same-cadence changes retain the existing renewal date; cadence changes reset the billing cycle and bill the full new amount without unused-time credit.

fields.name: StopCurrentBillingImmediately
fields.fieldText: Stop current billing immediately
fields.helpText: Stops the current cadence in Stripe during this Flow interaction. No payment is collected until the selected date, when Stripe invoices the full new amount. No refund or unused-time credit is created.

fields.name: StripeImmediateStopSummary
fields.fieldText:
Immediate billing stop

Stop date: Today

No-charge gap: Today through {!StartDate}

New transaction: {!GiftTransactionAmount} on {!StartDate}, then every {!GiftTransactionInterval} {!GiftTransactionPeriodPicklist}

Paid transactions remain unchanged. Stripe creates no refund, credit, or proration adjustment.
